description.value: IGA Murrayville is a full-service neighbourhood supermarket on 48th Avenue in Langley's Murrayville area, part of the IGA Stores of BC network. It carries a broad range of fresh produce, meat, dairy, deli, bakery, and household goods, making it a practical resupply stop for cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley. The store's extensive department selection—including prepared and ready-to-eat meals—is well suited for touring cyclists looking to stock up quickly.
